enchantment.imbuence.shadow_walker.desc: Grants buffs while in the shadow.
enchantment.imbuence.combat_engineer.des: While in main-hand, has a chance to repair the tool when attacked.
enchantment.imbuence.crime.desc: Blocking with a shield inflicts Judgement on the attacker.
enchantment.imbuence.punishment.desc: Increases damage against targets with Judgement.
enchantment.imbuence.sacred_corona.desc: Grants Sancta Potentia during the day. It seems to be carrying out a long overdue mission...
enchantment.imbuence.shining_maria.desc: Grants Mare Potentia during the night. It seems to be seeking a long overdue revenge...
enchantment.imbuence.fortress.desc: Increases all damage dealt based on the wearer's maximum health, even more when barehanded.
enchantment.imbuence.multiplate.desc: Limits the amount of damage taken per attack at the cost of durability.
enchantment.imbuence.awareness.desc: Periodically blocks the next instance of damage.
enchantment.imbuence.preparation.desc: Grants buffs when being the one initiating combat, recharges by staying out of combat.
enchantment.imbuence.afterburner.desc: Raises the minimum flight duration of firework rockets during flight.
enchantment.imbuence.rocket_specialist.d: Vastly improves firework rockets but makes this weapon no longer accept arrows.
enchantment.imbuence.defiance.desc: Reduces shield disable cooldown while knocking back and slowing the disabler.
enchantment.imbuence.puzzle.desc: Provides different effects depending on the number of armor pieces and hand items that have this enchantment.
enchantment.imbuence.curse_of_the_dragon: While underwater, time since last rest accumulates faster. May interact with certain items in special ways...
enchantment.imbuence.wolf_pack.desc: Grants nearby pets buffs depending on the number of surrounding pets. A wolf counts as 2 pets.
enchantment.imbuence.commander.desc: Grants bonus attack damage for every nearby pet. A wolf counts as 2 pets.
effect.imbuence.sancta_potentia.descript: All arrows inflict bonus flat damage on impact. Becomes immune to even-numbered damage below 5 on even-numbered tiles.
effect.imbuence.mare_potentia.descriptio: All arrows inflict percentage bonus damage on impact. Becomes immune to odd-numbered damage below 5 on odd-numbered tiles.
effect.imbuence.forbidden_syzygy.descrip: Applies the effect of both Sancta Potentia and Mare Potentia. Additionally applies Glowing to targets hit by your arrows.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_3: Rules for Three, Not for Me
imbuence.advancement.root.desc: An extra touch of magic on your adventure.
imbuence.advancement.daybreak.desc: Stage a reunion full of scars.
imbuence.advancement.turtle.desc: Unlock the secrets of the curse.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_1.desc: Have 1 piece of equipment enchanted with Puzzle. Effect: Reduces experience levels consumed when enchanting or anvilling.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_2.desc: Have 2 pieces of equipment enchanted with Puzzle. Effect: Reduces animal breeding cooldown and villager conversion duration.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_3.desc: Have 3 pieces of equipment enchanted with Puzzle. Effect: Grants Luck 3.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_4.desc: Have 4 pieces of equipment enchanted with Puzzle. Effect: Makes faraway attackers slow, glow and afflicted with Judgement IV.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_5.desc: Have 5 pieces of equipment enchanted with Puzzle. Effect: Drinking potion doubles duration of positive and neutral effects. Movement exhausts hunger slower while under 5 or more status effects.
imbuence.advancement.puzzle_6.desc: Have 6 pieces of equipment enchanted with Puzzle. Effect: Reduces damage taken from those with more maximum health than you.
